items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: when I knew them, they had ... Henry Zeno playing drum ... Sidney Bechet on clarinet.

ctx.x: But it looked something like him.

And a very good trumpet player. He could make sense of, well Bump played with him at one time too. But when I knew them, they had Joe Johnson on trumpet, Frankie Dooson trombone, Jim Dandy playing bass, Jeff Mumford playing guitar, Henry Zeno playing drum, I wish he could have lived for you to hear him playing drums. Yeah, I've heard of him. He was great. And, uh, I see it was, uh, Daniels on bass, Jeff Mumford on guitar, Sidney Bechet on clarinet.
Do you remember old man Willie Umphrey? That is not our young man.
